sinopsis.es: La llegada de un refrigerador cambia la vida en La Raya, un pueblo abandonado en la sierra sur de Oaxaca. Sotera y su amigo Erick intentan venderlo y hacer negocio. Sin embargo, el refrigerador pronto empieza a revelar cosas misteriosas a la gente que se le acerca.
sinopsis.en: The arrival of a refrigerator changes life in La Raya, an abandoned village in the southern mountains of Oaxaca. Sotera and her friend Erick try to sell it and make a business. However, the fridge soon begins to reveal mysterious things to the people who approach it.
